papers.title: Breaking Failure Cascades: Step-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Medical Multimodal Reasoning (MRPO)
papers.what: Adds step-wise process rewards to GRPO for medical multimodal reasoning: when the answer is wrong, earlier invalid reasoning steps get exponentially larger penalties. Cuts early-stage reasoning failures from 64.0% to 13.0% and lets Qwen3-VL-8B beat HuatuoGPT-Vision-34B by 2.79 points.
papers.builds_on: DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); Latent-GRPO (Deng 2026, U4ZPM5DN); Med-VQA Hallucination (Wu 2024, ATEFZQA4)

papers.title: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Interactive Radiology Report Drafting
papers.what: Fine-tunes a diffusion language model (DiffusionGemma-26B, 3.8B active) for medical VQA against its autoregressive sibling under an identical LoRA recipe. Diffusion matches or beats autoregression, decodes 3.5-4.4x faster, and adds training-free any-order infill so a radiologist can pin fragments and have the model fill the gaps.

papers.title: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.what: Replaces the ever-growing agent transcript with a bounded contract: each decision is built from a fresh prompt via typed retrieval, so prompt size stays fixed and each memory layer can be ablated in isolation. Tested in Slay the Spire 2; a triggered skill layer moves wins from 3/10 to 6/10 (directional, p~0.37). Releases 298 tagged trajectories.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026, BDY3HUCV); LATS (Zhou 2024, 77ERE7HA); ADaPT (Prasad 2023, J8DYBKW2)

papers.title: Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models (FlashMorph)
papers.what: Frames hybrid full-vs-linear attention layer selection as budget-constrained subset optimization. A morphable model gives each full-attention layer a linear branch; frozen weights and jointly learned per-layer gates on synthetic long-context data pick the hybrid config at lower cost while keeping long-context recall.
papers.builds_on: Mamba (Gu 2024, XNI34DQX); Attention Is All You Need (Vaswani 2017, PHB9VRVM)
